headline: Stage 3c shipped: the goal matrix — 8 goals trained, gaming predicted before it happened
lede: Predictions went in before any training (Gemma proxies under #2529-A — DeepSeek-V4-Flash turned out to be physically unloadable here). Eight goals then trained at the hard stamp and each spent its one held-out pass. Only bodyguard and progress beat the BC warm start; fast gamed itself into suicide runs, selfish into abandonment — both named by both proxies before training. Stage 3 is complete.

notes.text: #2516 shipped & closed: matrix 33 rows (rl 6963009), registry audit clean; bodyguard 5/8 val is the honest winner (hero deaths 6.9→4.4).
Prediction scorecard: proxy direction recall 3-for-3 (all three gamed goals named pre-training); win magnitudes overestimated on 6 of 8 goals — direction useful, numbers not.
Two live-run-only bugs found and pinned: run3c logs/ mkdir (#12) and models/ prefix in held-out --model (#13, self-test 9/9) — the second crashed all eight held-outs without burning them.
DeepSeek-V4-Flash is capacity-impossible on the Studio (287/422GB weights vs ~206GB ceiling) — earlier 'reachable' claim corrected; the local proxy pool is Gemma-only.
